name: gq-support
description: WordPress plugin: in-dashboard support issue submission and status widget

scripts.wp:start: ddev start gq-support-testsite && pnpm run wp:update
scripts.wp:update: ddev exec -p gq-support-testsite composer update roots/wordpress --with-all-dependencies --no-interaction && ddev exec -p gq-support-testsite wp plugin update --all
scripts.wp:check: ddev exec -p gq-support-testsite wp plugin check gq-support
scripts.lint:php: ddev exec -p gq-support-testsite --dir /var/www/html/web/app/plugins/gq-support composer install --quiet && ddev exec -p gq-support-testsite --dir /var/www/html/web/app/plugins/gq-support vendor/bin/phpcs
scripts.lint:php:fix: ddev exec -p gq-support-testsite --dir /var/www/html/web/app/plugins/gq-support composer install --quiet && ddev exec -p gq-support-testsite --dir /var/www/html/web/app/plugins/gq-support vendor/bin/phpcbf
scripts.analyse:php: ddev exec -p gq-support-testsite --dir /var/www/html/web/app/plugins/gq-support composer install --quiet && ddev exec -p gq-support-testsite --dir /var/www/html/web/app/plugins/gq-support composer analyse
